text: Hey Hero, let's play a game. I'll name something and you tell me asset or liability. Ready? Okay, let's go. Stocks. Asset. Credit card debt. Liability. Gold. Asset. Home loan. Liability. Mutual funds. Asset. House. Asset. Car. Asset. Car loan. Liability. Designer bag. Asset. Okay then. Luxury watch. Asset. An asset doesn't have to be a good investment. Your husband? Good one.
